question: Can guardrails alone prevent prompt injection in agents?
message:
Question: Can guardrails alone prevent prompt injection in agents?

## s1. Can guardrails alone prevent prompt injection in agents?
- (supports) Guardrails alone cannot prevent prompt injection. [doc-005]
- (supports) Detection-style defenses can reach very low attack success rates. [doc-010]

## s2. What are the limitations of using guardrails to prevent prompt injection in AI agents?
- (supports) Guardrails alone cannot prevent prompt injection. [doc-005]

## s3. Can adversarial training alone be an effective countermeasure to prompt injection in AI agents?
- (supports) Guardrails and similar defenses are not reliable on their own against adaptive attackers. [doc-009]
